correctness.rationale: Independently recomputed with a third from-scratch Murnaghan-Nakayama implementation (beta-set rim-hook code distinct from candidate's abacus code): S_n character tables for n=1..12 match candidate chartable_n.json entry-for-entry including partition order; Method-A vs Method-B tables agree at all n. Exhaustively recomputed all Kronecker inner products (1/z-weighted class sums, exact divisibility) for n<=10: nonzero counts 1,4,11,43,143,511,1599,5048,14294,40860 and maxima 1,1,1,1,2,5,9,17,28,117 exactly reproduce kron_nonzero files and DRAFT Table (a); S3-symmetry spot-checked. Argmax uniqueness verified: n=10 has exactly 1 ordered argmax ((4,3,2,1)^3); n=6 unique, n=7 4 ordered, n=8 unique, n=9 4 ordered as claimed. Ray recomputed: g=4 at every n=6..12 with zero remainder. argmax_n10_cert.json verified term-by-term: 42 class sizes match n!/z, chi values match table row for (4,3,2,1) cubed, each contrib=size*chi^3, sum=424569600=117*10!. Orthogonality/hook-dimension/transpose checks are entailed by table equality with verified tables. Result is exact exhaustive computation (proof by certified enumeration), not sampling; limits honestly stated (in-window n0, no claim beyond n=12 computationally).

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: (1) Briand-Orellana-Rosas 0907.4652 proves general exact stabilization indices/bounds but publishes no n<=10 atlas, no threshold on ray ((n-3,2,1),(n-3,2,1),(n-2,1,1)), no M(10)=117 witness. (2) Sam-Snowden 1501.00333 proves Stembridge stability structurally (FI-modules/Hilbert functions), no small-n tables or witnesses. (3) Pak-Panova-Vallejo 1304.0738 proves hook/two-row containment for Saxl squares, no complete tables. (4) Vallejo 1310.8362 gives polynomial/stability results for Kronecker squares, different property. (5) Closest computational prior Sun-Zhang-Zhu 2407.18152 computes full Kronecker data only for S6; n=7..10 tables, n=11,12 ray points, M(10)=117 unpublished. Internal SCOPE024 (1728-row weight<=4 padded census n=6..10) does overlap the ray core ((2,1),(2,1),(1,1)) at n=6..10 as a subset row, but its headline is the (3,1)^3 delay witness and it stops at n=10 with max 18; it does not contain the complete all-triples atlas (74088 ordered triples at n=10 alone), the n=11,12 ray extension, or the M(10)=117 maximal witness. Failed attempt SCOPE-FAIL-20260908-017 (S8 max 17, counts 511/1599/5048) was never validated, stopped at n=8 with single method, and contains no n=9,10 atlas or ray certificate. Conjunctive atlas+ray-through-12+argmax package is new.

value.rationale: Headline judged separately from surrounding census: (i) exact maximum M(10)=117 uniquely at ((4,3,2,1)^3) with 42-term class-sum certificate, (ii) Murnaghan-ray exact values g_n=4 for n=6..12 (n0=6 in-window, g*=4), (iii) complete dual-certified zero/nonzero census n<=10 with per-n maxima. Object (S_n Kronecker coefficients) and invariants (maxima, stability values) were motivated before computation by Murnaghan/Stembridge stability, Saxl staircase positivity, and GCT positivity benchmarks; values are not known or mechanically implied (M(10)=117 jumps from 28; ray constant 4 requires evaluation). A future researcher can reasonably need the precise maximum/witness and ray stable value as benchmark data. This is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. Certification strengthens but does not substitute for this substantive benchmark value.
